I took the plate as a standard dinner plate, about 26 cm across. In the image it spans roughly 450 px, so about 17 px per cm.

- **Rice:** It covers about 150 x 220 px, which is roughly 9 x 13 cm. At a height of about 2 cm that comes to around 130 g cooked, so I estimated 150 g.
- **Brussels sprouts:** I count about 7 to 8 sprouts at roughly 15 g each, so about 110 g. Some are roasted and cut, so I settled on 100 g.
- **Steak:** There are three pieces, together about 9 x 4 cm and 2 cm thick. That is roughly 72 cm³, or about 80 g, so I estimated 90 g.
- **Pizza:** There are two slices or pieces with cheese and sauce, about 8 x 7 cm and 1.5 cm thick, so about 80 g.
- **Chicken breast:** It has a cheese and tomato topping, about 6 x 6 cm and 3 cm thick. That is roughly 100 g, so I estimated 90 g.
